thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P0 — gpu-pool-eu-2 capacity_exhaustion. queue_length=18k, average_latency=2.3s, error_rate=11%. paging @oncall-ai

oncall-ai: I'm on it. seeing sustained queue growth since 02:12 UTC. autoscaler attempted scale at 02:15 and 02:18 but both failed (quota/403).

sre-alex: Confirmed. cloud API returned \"RequestQuotaExceeded\" on scale calls. Logs: 
```
2026-03-17T02:18:03Z scale_request(pool=gpu-pool-eu-2) -> 403 RequestQuotaExceeded provider: vCPU quota
```

ml-ops-joy: Customer impact: a few PLG customers reported timeouts for chat generation and increased 429s. Support has 12 tickets tied to this.

support-liz: I've messaged affected customers with the standard outage note and ETA 30m, collecting config examples. one large tenant shows 700 concurrent sessions.

eng-runtime-nina: Autoscaler hit max_retries 3 then backoff. There's a guard that prevents repeated scale if provider returns quota errors; it didn't open fallback path to alternate pools.

oncall-ai: Quick mitigation options: (1) evict low-priority jobs, (2) route new requests to cpu-fallback cluster, (3) temporarily tighten per-tenant rate limits, (4) request emergency quota. Which do we run now?

sre-alex: Start with evictions + routing. Evict policy: tenant_priority<=low, reclaim 30% of pool. Running eviction command now.

ml-ops-joy: I'm enabling CPU fallback routes for text-gen model variant v1-cpu for non-SLA tenants. That should lower GPU pressure.

eng-runtime-nina: Pushing route change:
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routes/modify \
  -d '{\"from_pool\":\"gpu-pool-eu-2\",\"to_pool\":\"cpu-pool-eu-1\",\"selector\":\"!tenant.sla_premium\"}'
```
Deployed in 60s.

oncall-ai: Eviction run completed: reclaimed ~28% (14/50 instances freed). queue_length dropped to 9.1k. latency down to 1.1s for routed traffic.

support-liz: Tickets: two customers still seeing errors (premium tenants). Escalated to SE for mitigation.

sre-alex: For premium tenants we need targeted capacity. Can we spawn a dedicated burst in eu-1? Provider quota is global but eu-1 shows spare capacity. Need someone to open emergency provisioning with cloud console.

eng-runtime-nina: Opening ephemeral pool in eu-1 now, using existing reserved images. Command:
```
infra-cli create-pool --region eu-1 --gpu-type a10 --size 8 --tags emergency
```

ml-ops-joy: Pool created and registered, but autoscaler policy didn't attach. Manually routing 20% of premium requests to new pool.

incident-bot: NOTE: incident mitigation in progress. update interval 5m.

product-ops-max: Any customer-facing ETA we can give? Support wants a firm estimate for premium customers.

support-liz: We told them 30m earlier; at 02:35 we can say mitigations have reduced impact and we're scaling extra capacity.

oncall-ai: Root cause summary so far: bursty tenant(s) caused queue growth, autoscaler attempts were blocked by provider quota errors; circuit for fallback to alternate regions/pools did not trigger for premium routes.

sre-alex: After routing + eviction + emergency pool, error rate down to 1.2%, queue ~900. Throttling still present for some requests; marking incident as stabilized but we're not done.

eng-runtime-nina: Postmortem action items I propose:
- Add alert for \"scale_request_rejected\" with reason (quota) -> page infra team
- Implement cross-region fallback for premium tenants when pool saturated
- Make autoscaler retry/backoff policy attempt alternate pools instead of failing fast
- Add dynamic per-tenant emergency burst policy and test it in chaos env

ml-ops-joy: Also: create a regression test that simulates quota-denied scaling and validate fallback path. Add load tests for multi-tenant spikes.

support-liz: Create customer follow-up notes: timeline + mitigations + next steps. I'll draft and share.

product-ops-max: We should consider a conservative default per-tenant concurrency cap to avoid noisy neighbors; propose default 200 concurrent sessions for new tenants.

oncall-ai: Agreement. I'll create the incident ticket with timeline and owners. Ticket: INF-2026-047. Owning teams: eng-runtime (nina), SRE (alex), ML-ops (joy), Support (liz).

sre-alex: Quick follow-ups before closing thread: run through cause matrix, attach relevant logs (scale_reject logs, autoscaler traces), verify quota request placed with provider, schedule postmortem sync 48h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT status -> STABILIZED at 02:43 UTC. total_duration=31m. impact: partial for PLG, limited for premium until emergency pool attached.

support-liz: Customer update sent. Will post copy to #customer-status channel.

eng-runtime-nina: I'm making a PR for autoscaler fallback in 2h (link to diff will be in ticket).

ml-ops-joy: I'll schedule chaos test for quota-failure path next week.

oncall-ai: Great work team. Closing live triage. Postmortem owners, please prepare draft by EOD tomorrow.

sre-alex: closing notes: stabilized, monitoring for 3h. action items assigned in INF-2026-047. Thanks all. :tada:
